title: eremophila willsii subsp. integrifolia
intro: Eremophila willsii subsp. integrifolia, commonly known as a shrub species within the Eremophila genus, is a plant native to Western Australia. This shrub has been traditionally used in Western Australian Indigenous medicine to treat various health conditions, and its health benefits include the potential to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory function, and alleviate gastrointestinal issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Eremophila willsii subsp. integrifolia include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
